killer_test.name: unique_trigger_skill_retrieved_used_grounded_traced

Drive anima.server._turn with a TASK-shaped request that matches only that skill. Assert: _lerf_eligible returns a rung-3 lerf_skill route for the unique trigger (and returns None for a feeling/personal/conversational turn — the #1-rule exclusion holds); the rendered answer is grounded-verified (router rung-5 small_local_verified, grounded True) BEFORE shipping; backend is lerf:*; and the LERF route ledger line + the whole_mri trace record lerf.solved True for this turn. Real .anima byte-unchanged.

must_contain: <a token the skill's contract REQUIRES in its output>
